title: Stuffed Peppers with {p}
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and cook the {s} until just tender.
Brown the {p} with the {spice}, then mix in the {s} and half the {sauce}.
Cut the tops off the {v}, scoop out the seeds and stuff them. Stand them in a dish, spoon over the rest of the {sauce}, cover and bake 35 to 40 minutes, until the filling is at least 165°F / 74°C.
tip: Use lean turkey or beans, plenty of rice or quinoa, and skip the cheese topping.
